acceptedAnswer.text: KFC is located at 1229 U.S. Hwy 127 S, Frankfort, KY 40601, USA. This is where you will go to get DoorDash Pickup orders, and where Dashers will go to get your DoorDash delivery orders.

mainEntity.name: Does KFC offer delivery or pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can browse KFC’s menu and place an order for both Delivery and Pickup on DoorDash. KFC may also offer delivery and pickup on their own or through other delivery services.

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular dishes at KFC?

acceptedAnswer.text: The dishes most commonly ordered by DoorDash customers at KFC are Pot Pie, Cole Slaw and 3 pc. Chicken Big Box Meal.

mainEntity.name: Is KFC a DashPass eligible store?

acceptedAnswer.text: KFC offers DashPass benefits like $0 delivery, reduced service fees, and $5 credits back on Pickup orders. If you want to know if a store is DashPass eligible, you can look for the DashPass icon next to their name.
